text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Look at this huge crowd... Today 
isn't the Japan Derby, right?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Haha. Well, who wouldn't want to watch 
today's race? I mean, after all—

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"—Because the only ones here are those 
everyone looks up to."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Inhaaaale... Exhaaale...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...I came to see you from behind.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Cesario! ......

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"...You made it in time. Are your injuries 
all right now?"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Naturally. To not be present in such a 
place would simply be far too great a 
regret.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Now, let's go. Toward the race of our 
dreams.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: —Right!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (—I'm sure I'll never forget this day.)

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: Mom, look. Air Groove-san is running.

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
She's the Umamusume who won the Oaks—the 
race the two of us went to see when I 
first came to Tokyo.

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
The days I spent chasing after everyone in 
the Mejiro family were the only treasure I 
had when I had nothing else.

text_block_list.name: Spectator E
text_block_list.text:
I swore that as long as Ikuno Dictus kept 
running, I'd never ever quit my job.

text_block_list.name: Spectator F
text_block_list.text:
North Flight really is a star. If anyone 
can take down the Sprint King, Sakura 
Bakushin O... I believe it's her.

text_block_list.name: Spectator G
text_block_list.text:
"You know, even when facing an opponent 
everyone else gave up on, I loved how 
Hishi Amazon clung to the hope of victory. 
I loved that about her so much!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(Amidst the overflowing memories, those 
stars continue to shine brightly.)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(As if tracing that line, we started 
running too.)

text_block_list.name: Spectator H
text_block_list.text:
"When Sweep Tosho won the Takarazuka 
Kinen, I thought to myself: History is 
about to change!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator I
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't believe it when Cesario won 
that American GⅠ!! She truly was the queen 
we'd all been waiting for!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (Searching for a path of my very own—)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: —Rhein Kraft-san!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(...Kawakami Princess-san! She's been 
undefeated since her debut and is running 
on the Tiara route—)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hehehehe... Ohohoho! *cough* *cough* 
*hack*!! ...*ahem*!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I made it in time tooooo~!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I'll crush all of you past champions! The 
one who will become Queen is me, a 
Classic-class runner!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Even against you, who shine brighter than 
anyone, I will not lose! Let us have a 
fair and square match!!"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
—Craft. The way you run stirs the souls of 
horse girls across every generation.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...From here on, the future woven upon 
this turf will be the continuation of the 
scenery you showed us.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: "Let's have fun. —Craft."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: —Yeah.
